attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Connecticut state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per Conn. Gen. Stat. § 12-700: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 6.99%. Standard deductions: $0 Single/MFS, $24,000 MFJ/QSS, $19,000 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Connecticut Tax Calculation (top marginal 6.99%)" to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Connecticut Tax Calculation (top marginal 6.99%)" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 24000.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.0699
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 24000.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.0699 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 19000.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.0699
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 19000.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.0699 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 0.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * 0.0699
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi 0.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income 0.0699 fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: CT MFJ: 6.99% x max(AGI - $24,000, 0) per Conn. Gen. Stat. § 12-700
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "CT MFJ: 6.99% x max(AGI - $24,000, 0) per Conn. Gen. Stat. § 12-700"
